stem: Preserved edges with an autolyzed center most strongly suggests:
rationale: A thick specimen fixes from the surface inward and may remain underfixed centrally.

distractor_rationales.A: Bluing affects hematoxylin color and does not create central autolysis with preserved tissue edges.
distractor_rationales.B: A dull microtome blade produces sectioning artifacts after processing, not an underfixed specimen center.
distractor_rationales.D: Coverslip bubbles are mounting artifacts and do not explain autolysis within the tissue block.

learning_objective: Identify excessive specimen thickness from the pattern of preserved edges and central autolysis.
